tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window background behind every screen. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, bento tiles, board columns and panels. Text on it: `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`, status colors.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elements that sit on a `surface`: inputs, secondary buttons, pipeline cards, popovers. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the job tray well, code or log drawers, table headers. Text: `ink`, `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders. Not for controls (use `line-strong`).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls (inputs, secondary buttons, toggles) and any mark that carries meaning. 3:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand accent: primary buttons, active nav, fit-score rings, links, focus ring. Also text on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `accent-soft` (4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet tint behind selected items and info badges. Text on it: `accent` or `ink`.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an `accent` fill (primary button). Never use literal white or black there.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, connected, offer. Text on `surface` and `success-soft`. Always paired with a word or the check glyph.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind success badges and the 'ready' state of a checklist row.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention, not broken: update available, review waiting. Text on `surface` and `warning-soft`. Always paired with a word or the triangle glyph.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning badges and review cards.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed, blocked, rejected. Text on `surface` and `danger-soft`. Always paired with a word or the cross glyph. Rejections are shown in `ink-muted`, not danger: the color is for system failures.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger badges and failed checklist rows.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 3px focus outline on every interactive element; an alias of `accent`, 3:1 on all four surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: stage-shortlisted
tokens.usage: Pipeline column marker for Shortlisted.

tokens.name: stage-applied
tokens.usage: Pipeline column marker for Applied.

tokens.name: stage-interviewing
tokens.usage: Pipeline column marker for Interviewing.

tokens.name: stage-offer
tokens.usage: Pipeline column marker for Offer.

tokens.name: stage-rejected
tokens.usage: Pipeline column marker for Rejected / Closed. Muted on purpose.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Three roles look like a strong fit this week.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels and column headers.

styles.name: num-xl
styles.usage: Key number in a bento tile.

styles.name: num-md
styles.usage: Fit score inside a ring, counts in badges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles on the bento strip and between board cards.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside small controls and list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding (compact), gap between sections of a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tile padding, screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between major regions of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Onboarding page margins, empty-state spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges' inner glyphs, small chips, log rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, pipeline cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Bento tiles, board columns, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, toggles, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Bento tiles and board columns.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, the job tray when expanded, modals.
